dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Top of the basilar syndrome from basilar artery embolism, most likely due to paradoxical embolism through a patent foramen ovale

ALTERNATIVES:
1. Vertebral artery dissection with artery-to-artery embolism to the basilar tip
2. Fabry disease (X-linked, posterior circulation stroke in young males, often with vertebrobasilar dolichoectasia)
3. Primary CNS vasculitis (requires conventional angiography or biopsy to exclude)
